title: hamiltonians-canonical-transform widget params
description: Bespoke widget for the §3 canonical transformations preview on the hamiltonians-classical-mechanics topic. Renders a single .row containing both a `<select>` (map family: rotation / shear / squeeze / a non-canonical control case) and a `<input type="range">` parameter slider, then an SVG host showing a unit square transported by the chosen linear map, plus a readout reporting whether |det J| = 1. The select-AND-slider-on-the-same-row layout is bespoke; parametric-plot's pick row is a separate row from its slider row.

trailing.description: ARTIFACT. Whitespace-only string emitted between the closing quote of `value` and the `>` — preserves a single source <option value="non" > with a stray space.

slider.description: The single parameter slider rendered to the right of the <select> in the same .row.

sectionComment.description: ARTIFACT. Optional /* ... */ banner before the IIFE.

bodyScript.x-artifact: script body is bespoke; portable consumers should implement their own linear-map draw logic from {pick.options, slider} alone
bodyScript.description: ARTIFACT. Verbatim JS statements that go inside `(function(){\n…\n})();` — wires the select + slider, applies the chosen 2x2 linear map to a unit square, and updates the readout's |det J| label.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer <div class="widget">. Required by the corpus-wide test-widget-renderers convention.
